title: Tenure Track Position in Business Technology
description:
Description

The Tepper School of Business at Carnegie Mellon University invites
applicants for an open rank tenure-track faculty position in
Business Technology to begin in Fall 2027. Candidates must have
interest and capacity to conduct high quality research and
potential to publish in top-tier business journals. We welcome
theoretical, methodological, and empirical research on AI/ML, with
particular interest in LLM methods and their applications to
business problems.

Qualifications

Applicants are expected to have a doctoral degree at the time of
appointment in Information Systems, Economics, Marketing,
Operations Research, Computer Science/Machine Learning, or related
fields. Applicants who have already completed their PhD and have a
strong record in both business research and teaching are also
encouraged to apply and will be considered for the position.
Candidates must also have potential to teach at a high level of
competency, as documented by teaching evaluations or letters of
recommendation.

The ideal candidate will play a leading role in advancing the
school’s strategic goal of intelligent future, which is a
long-standing differentiator of the Tepper School’s approach to
business education and research. The Tepper School of Business and
Carnegie Mellon University have a strong culture of collaboration
across disciplines which provides unique opportunities where highly
innovative and interdisciplinary work is encouraged. The Tepper
School is committed to building a community of faculty and welcomes
candidates whose experience in teaching, research, or community
service has prepared them to contribute to our commitment to
academic excellence.

Application Instructions

Applicants should submit an application letter, vita, up to three
published or unpublished research papers, and three recommendation
letters via Interfolio.

Review of applications will begin September 10, 2026. A
faculty committee will interview shortlisted candidates via Zoom
interview. For full consideration, applications should be submitted
by September 20, 2026. Applications may continue to be
considered until the position is filled, subject to school
policy.

Questions about the application can be addressed to Mr. Phillip
Conley, Faculty Search Coordinator for Business Technology,
pconley@cmu.edu.

Carnegie Mellon University seeks to meet the needs of dual-career
couples.

For more information about the Business Technology group please
visit our webpage at:


https://www.cmu.edu/tepper/faculty-and-research/academic-areas/business-technologies/index.html
